termsAndConditions.title: Pricing
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Per-square-foot basis; actual area depends on site conditions & installed quantity.
termsAndConditions.fullText: All prices are calculated on a per-square-foot (sq. ft.) basis. The actual area may vary depending on site conditions and the final quantity required during installation.

termsAndConditions.title: Rental Period
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Quoted price applicable for 28 days (1 month). Exceeding by 1 day incurs monthly charges.
termsAndConditions.fullText: The quoted price is applicable for 28 days (1 month). If the rental period exceeds 28 days by even 1 day, the applicable monthly charges will be charged.

termsAndConditions.title: Transportation
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Extra 2-way charges applicable for both delivery and return transportation.
termsAndConditions.fullText: Transportation charges are extra and will be charged for both delivery and return transportation (2-way charges).

termsAndConditions.title: Walkway Jali
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: 1 walkway Jali included per unit; additional Jali charged at ₹200 per piece.
termsAndConditions.fullText: 1 walkway Jali is included with each unit of scaffolding. Any additional walkway Jali will be charged at ₹200 per piece.

termsAndConditions.title: Shifting Charges
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Extra customer-borne charges: ₹6 per sq. ft. or 60% of the per-unit amount.
termsAndConditions.fullText: Shifting charges are extra and shall be borne by the customer. Charges will be ₹6 per sq. ft. or 60% of the per-unit amount, as applicable.

termsAndConditions.title: Order Cancellation
termsAndConditions.fullText: Once the order is confirmed, it cannot be cancelled.

termsAndConditions.title: Payment Terms
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: 75% advance before installation; remaining 25% post-installation completion.
termsAndConditions.fullText: 75% advance payment is required before installation. The remaining 25% shall be paid after completion of installation.

termsAndConditions.title: Monthly Payment
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Due on next day after completion of each 28-day rental period.
termsAndConditions.fullText: For extended rental periods, the monthly rental payment must be made on the next day after completion of each 28-day/month rental period.

termsAndConditions.title: Damage or Misplacement
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Customer liable for damage, loss, or misplacement at prevailing material values.
termsAndConditions.fullText: The customer shall be responsible for any damage, loss, or misplacement of scaffolding material at the site. The value of damaged or missing material will be charged according to the prevailing material value on the date of assessment.

termsAndConditions.title: Post-Installation Visit
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Visits after installation completion are chargeable by location and scope.
termsAndConditions.fullText: Any visit required after completion of installation will be chargeable, depending on the location and nature of the visit.

termsAndConditions.title: Challan & Material Responsibility
termsAndConditions.shortSummary: Customer must approve delivery challan; uninstallation reconciled against approved challan.
termsAndConditions.fullText: At the time of installation, the customer must verify and approve the delivery challan containing details of all scaffolding materials supplied at the site. The customer shall be responsible for the safekeeping of all materials during the rental period. At the time of uninstallation, the materials will be verified against the approved delivery challan, and any shortage, loss, misplacement, or damage shall be charged to the customer as per the applicable material value.
